title: Field Marketing Executive
description:
**Field Marketing Executive – Maayaa Smart Automation**

**Location:** Tirupur, Tamil Nadu  
**Job type:** Part\-time  
**Work arrangement:** Hybrid — local field visits, office coordination and work from home for follow\-ups

Maayaa Smart Automation provides home automation and security solutions across Tamil Nadu. We are looking for a Field Marketing Executive to meet potential customers and business partners, understand their requirements and generate qualified leads.

**Responsibilities**

* Visit architects, builders, contractors and prospective customers in Tirupur and nearby areas.
* Introduce our home automation, CCTV, access control, gate automation and security solutions.
* Understand customer requirements and arrange meetings or site visits with our sales and technical team.
* Follow up with interested prospects by phone and WhatsApp.
* Maintain accurate records of visits, leads and next steps.

**Requirements**

* Clear spoken Tamil and working English.
* Confident communication and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to travel locally and maintain basic lead records.
* Field marketing or sales experience is preferred. Product training will be provided.

**To apply:** Submit your CV through Indeed, including your current location and relevant experience. whatsapp to 7904877268

Pay: ₹10,100\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Sales & Marketing Executive
description:
Sales \& Marketing Executive – Kids Apparel

Company: Artha Amogha Apparels

Location: Tirupur, Tamil NaduJobSales \& Marketing Executive – Kids Apparel

Company: Artha Amogha Apparels

About the Role

We are looking for a Sales \& Marketing Executive to help grow our kids’ clothing business and develop new customers and sales channels.

The ideal candidate should be target\-oriented, confident in communication, proactive in finding customers, and comfortable with both online and offline sales activities.

This is a hands\-on role. We are looking for someone who can generate leads, follow up with customers, convert enquiries into orders, and contribute directly to business growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and generate new customers and business opportunities.
* Contact potential retailers, wholesalers, resellers, distributors and other relevant buyers.
* Follow up regularly with leads and existing customers.
* Convert enquiries into actual orders and achieve monthly sales targets.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing customers and encourage repeat orders.
* Promote our kids’ clothing products offline
* Coordinate with the internal team regarding product availability, pricing, orders and dispatch.
* Collect customer feedback and identify new market opportunities.
* Maintain basic records of leads, follow\-ups, enquiries and sales.
* Visit customers/markets when required.

Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience in sales, marketing, business development or apparel/textile sales preferred.
* Experience in kidswear, garments, textiles, retail, wholesale or fashion will be an advantage.
* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Comfortable using WhatsApp, Instagram and basic computer applications.
* Should be energetic, self\-motivated and willing to make sales calls and follow up consistently.
* Must have a strong focus on achieving targets.
* Ability to work independently and take initiative.
* Candidates who are genuinely interested in building a career in sales are preferred.

What We Offer

* Fixed salary based on experience and capability.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Opportunity to grow with a growing kids’ apparel business.
* Hands\-on exposure to sales, marketing and business development.

Important

This is a target\-oriented sales role, not a purely desk\-based marketing position.

Candidates should be comfortable with making calls, generating leads, following up, actively acquiring customers, must travel within Tamilnadu.

How to Apply

Please apply with your updated resume.

In your application, mention:

* Current location
* Current/last salary
* Expected salary
* Total sales experience
* Apparel/textile experience, if any
* Notice period
* Whether you have experience in B2B/wholesale/retail sales

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Work Location: On the road
